props.name: group_by
props.meaning: Column the rows are grouped on. The source is sorted on it. Not read with `groupKey`. One of the two is required.

props.name: group_key
props.meaning: The value a row groups under, derived from the row and compared by its JSON text. The source's sort is left as the caller set it.

props.name: group_label
props.meaning: The header's text for a derived key; not read with `groupBy`. Without it the key reads as its own display name.

props.name: thumbnail
props.meaning: Field holding the thumbnail URL.

props.name: label_field
props.meaning: Field shown as the row's label. Defaults to the type's display name.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: The muted line under the label. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The caller's own sub-label. Wins over `subLabelField`.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: The right-aligned value at the end of the row.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: The caller's own right-aligned text. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Show the row's `code` beside the label when the two differ.

props.name: details
props.meaning: Extra values drawn under the label. The source must already read their paths.

props.name: statuses
props.meaning: Status rows by code.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Values render with its preferences, and an entity value links to the row's page when it carries a site.

props.name: density
props.meaning: Compact halves the vertical row padding and draws a row chip and badge a step smaller.

props.name: selectable
props.meaning: Draws a checkbox on each row.

props.name: collapsed
props.meaning: Which groups are shut, two-way. A bare key list is the open mode with those keys shut.

props.name: page_sizes
props.meaning: Rows per page offered in the footer. `pages` only.

props.name: max_height
props.meaning: Height of the scrolling body.

props.name: virtualize_after
props.meaning: Rows and headers above which the list draws only the lines on screen.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the read returned nothing.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Row text and thumbnail. A compact row takes the step below.

props.name: source
props.meaning: The rows and the order behind them.

props.name: paging
props.meaning: How the set is walked: a page number, a load-more row, or the scroller.

props.name: sort
props.meaning: The source's sort, two-way, so a SortPicker drops into `header`.

props.name: filters
props.meaning: The source's filter, two-way, so a FilterBar drops into `header`.

props.name: selection
props.meaning: The selected rows, two-way. Names loaded rows only.

props.name: get_row_id
props.meaning: How a row is keyed, in the DOM and in the selection. Default `Type:id`.

props.name: is_row_disabled
props.meaning: True for a row that cannot be selected or reached by Tab.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

events.name: select
events.when: A row was activated, when `selectable` is off.

events.name: collapsed_changed
events.when: A group was opened or shut.

slots.name: leading
slots.draws: Fixed-size slot at the start of the row, when `thumbnail` is not the one wanted: an avatar, a status glyph.

slots.name: row
slots.draws: Draws a row's contents. The list keeps the row's box.

slots.name: groupHeader
slots.draws: Draws a group header's contents, after its chevron. `column` is `null` for a derived key.

keyboard.does: Moves through group headers, checkboxes, rows and the footer.
Selects it, or emits the select event.

keyboard.key: ArrowDown on the last loaded row
keyboard.does: In `more` and `scroll`, asks for the next page. The cursor stays where it is until the rows arrive, then lands on the first of them.
